description: This PHP source file defines the PasswordStrengthValidationAPI class, which serves as an API endpoint for password strength validation within the OrangeHRM project. It handles HTTP POST requests to validate passwords, checks password policies, and returns strength metrics and messages. The class also utilizes traits and external services for configuration, internationalization, and password strength logic.
